categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Headman Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of high-precision CNC lathes. Its main product categories include high-end CNC lathes, parallel composite machining centers, automated production lines, and popular CNC lathes. These products serve industries such as automotive manufacturing, construction machinery, general equipment, aerospace, and military industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as spindle technology, servo turret technology, servo tailstock technology, and thermal compensation technology, all of which are fully domestically developed. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including modular and unitized production systems, intelligent automation, and integration of industrial software for smart manufacturing. The company is also developing five-axis five-linkage composite machining centers and ultra-high precision CNC lathes with static pressure technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in automotive manufacturing (including new energy vehicles), construction machinery, general machinery, aerospace, military, and robotics industries. The automotive sector, especially new energy vehicles, is a core market driving demand for the company's high-end CNC lathes. The company also serves emerging sectors like humanoid robots and solar energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Zhejiang Province (Yuhuan city) and Shanghai. It has a growing presence in domestic provincial markets and expanding export markets, despite some challenges due to international trade restrictions. Sales are divided between domestic (majority) and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Headman operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of CNC machine tools and intelligent equipment. It produces core components such as spindles, turrets, and tailstocks in-house, while sourcing some key parts like CNC systems and linear guides from specialized suppliers, including foreign brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-precision and high-end CNC lathe development, focusing on breakthroughs in ultra-high precision machining, five-axis composite machining, and intelligent manufacturing software. It emphasizes independent innovation supported by university collaborations and aims to expand its product portfolio with intelligent, automated, and flexible machining solutions. R&D investment accounts for about 6% of revenue, with ongoing projects in advanced machining centers and thermal compensation technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of CNC machine tools and automated production lines. The company employs a mix of direct sales and agency sales models, with direct sales dominant in the home province and agency sales more prevalent in other provinces and overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic high-end CNC lathe manufacturer and is the only listed company in China specializing exclusively in CNC lathes. It competes with international giants from Germany, Japan, and the US, as well as strong domestic players. Zhejiang Headman has established competitive advantages in precision, core component autonomy, and intelligent manufacturing, recognized by multiple national awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 765 million, a 15.31% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 25.8 million, down 12.27%. Total assets reached RMB 1.67 billion, up 14.83%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and production capacity expansion, with ongoing investments in new production bases and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Headman emphasizes high precision, reliability, and intelligent automation in its CNC machine tools, offering products with fully domestically developed core components and advanced thermal compensation. Its product differentiation lies in integrating high precision with flexible, automated, and composite machining capabilities, supported by proprietary industrial software and customer-tailored engineering solutions. The company aims to lead in the domestic high-end CNC lathe market by providing innovative, efficient, and cost-effective machining solutions.
